description:
NoBrainner connects your flashcard study progress and spaced repetition decks directly to ChatGPT. Once signed in, you can ask ChatGPT for a detailed overview of your current study stats, check your recent review activity, pinpoint your weakest cards, and get personalized recommendations on what to review next.

Additionally, you can use ChatGPT to instantly draft new study decks (such as vocabulary lists, practice questions, or topic summaries) and save them directly to your NoBrainner account after reviewing the draft.

defaultPrompt: What should I study today in the NoBrainner app?
Which of my decks is weakest right now, and what makes it weak?
Create a 20-card B1 English phrasal verbs deck. Show me the draft before saving.
